item.title: Most 911 Calls Routed to NYPD Tagged as Unrelated to Crime, Study Finds
item.description: The majority of 911 calls routed to the NYPD last year were described by dispatchers as unrelated to criminal activity, according to a new study released Wednesday by a criminal justice reform group. item.title: HOPE Count Finally Takes Measure of Homeless New Yorkers After Extreme Cold Snap
